title: Two Sum
description:
You are given an array of integers nums and an integer target.

Return the indices of the two numbers such that they add up to the target.

You may assume that each input has exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.

Return the answer in any order.
constraints:
2 <= nums.length <= 10^4

-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9

-10^9 <= target <= 10^9

Exactly one valid answer exists.
hints:
Try checking every possible pair.

How many combinations exist?
Can you find the number needed to complete the target while traversing the array?
A HashMap can help you find the required complement in O(1) time.
editorialApproach: One-pass hash map for O(1) lookups.
editorialAlgorithm:
1. Initialize map.
2. Iterate through nums.
3. Return indices when complement found.
